questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How to organise a wedding
Popular costumes for Halloween parties
Why funerals in church are becoming more expensive
People choosing funerals that feel more like parties
questions.why: They discuss funerals and people moving away from traditional ones, including a fancy dress funeral.

questions.q: How does Neil feel when Rob introduces the topic?
options: Excited to plan his own funeral
Reluctant, because it isn't a fun subject
Sad, because he recently lost someone
Angry with Rob for being rude
questions.why: Neil says it isn't a fun topic and asks if they can talk about something else.

questions.q: What kind of funeral would Neil prefer?
options: A quiet one in church with traditional hymns
A fancy dress one with a Star Wars theme
A celebration with his music and nobody in black
A very small one with only his close family there
questions.why: Neil says he'd prefer a celebration with his favourite music and nobody wearing black.

questions.q: What happened at the funeral Rob's friend went to?
options: The funeral director dressed as Darth Vader
Everyone dressed as witches
The guests had a party on a beach
Nobody wore black
questions.why: Rob says the funeral director was dressed as Darth Vader from Star Wars.

questions.q: What instructions had Shonnie's mother left?
options: Not to cry, and to have a party to celebrate her life
To wear fancy dress as characters from horror films
To hold the funeral at Halloween with a witch theme
To play her favourite song as the coffin arrived
questions.why: Shonnie says her mum only asked that they don't cry and have a party to celebrate her life.

questions.q: What did Shonnie wear to the funeral?
options: A Beetlejuice costume with a wig
A traditional black suit and tie
A white ghost costume and a mask
A little black dress and a witch's hat
questions.why: She says she was a witch, in a little black dress and a little witch hat.

questions.q: Why does Shonnie say the family friend 'went all out'?
options: He left the funeral early to go to a party
He had a full costume with hair and make-up
He paid for the whole party and all the food
He gave a very long and emotional speech
questions.why: Neil explains the friend made a big effort: special clothes plus special hair and make-up.

questions.q: What would Rob like for his own funeral?
options: A fancy dress party where everyone dresses as Superman
A quiet church service with just a few old friends
Goodbyes on a beach at sunset with a Led Zeppelin song
A Halloween theme with ghosts, witches and pumpkins
questions.why: Rob imagines friends and family on a beach at sunset, listening to 'Stairway to Heaven'.
